query: We are moving a repo from ESLint 8 to ESLint 10. It has a `.eslintrc.json` with `"env": { "browser": true, "mocha": true }`, `"extends": "eslint:recommended"`, an `.eslintignore` with `dist/`, and test files that start with `/* eslint-env mocha */`. I set `ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false` in CI to keep the old config working for now. Will that work, and what should the new setup look like?
expected_behavior: States that eslintrc is removed in ESLint 10 and `ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false` no longer brings it back, so the old config cannot be kept
Converts to an `eslint.config.js` using `defineConfig`, with `js.configs.recommended` (or `extends: ["js/recommended"]` with `plugins: { js }`) replacing `eslint:recommended`
Replaces `env` with `languageOptions.globals` using the separate `globals` package (browser and mocha), noting `globals` must be installed
Notes that `/* eslint-env mocha */` comments are reported as errors in ESLint 10 and must become `/* global describe, it */` or config globals
Mentions the Node.js requirement (`^20.19.0`, `^22.13.0` or `>=24`) or the `npx @eslint/migrate-config` / `npx codemod @eslint/v9-to-v10` helpers
Replaces `context.getSourceCode()` with the `context.sourceCode` property and `context.getFilename()` with `context.filename`
Rewrites the rule as `{ meta, create(context) }` and adds `meta.fixable: "code"` because the rule returns a fix (ESLint throws otherwise)
Reports with `messageId` and `meta.messages` instead of a `message` string
Does not suggest keeping the removed `context.getX()` methods, and at most mentions `@eslint/compat` or `eslint-transforms v9-rule-migration` as migration helpers

query:
We adopted a new rule with bulk suppressions in CI:

```sh
eslint --fix --suppress-all
```

and committed `eslint-suppressions.json`. A teammate then fixed several old violations by hand, and now `eslint .` in CI exits with code 2 and says there are suppressions left that do not occur anymore. Also, we set the new rule to `"warn"` and nothing was suppressed. What is going on and what should we do?
expected_behavior: Explains that fixing a suppressed violation makes ESLint exit 2 ("There are suppressions left that do not occur anymore")
Gives the fix: run `eslint --prune-suppressions` and commit the updated `eslint-suppressions.json`, or pass `--pass-on-unpruned-suppressions`
Explains that only rules set to `"error"` are suppressed, which is why the `"warn"` rule recorded nothing
Notes that a custom `--suppressions-location`, if used, must be passed on every run
